SEARCH
Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class BrowseService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.BrowseService
public class BrowseService extends Object
UC8 Browse Marketplace, for the Buyer (Tasks 1.3 and 1.4): searching, filtering and sorting the live listings, opening a listing's detail, and viewing the seller's profile and reviews. 

 List<Listing> results = browse.search(new BrowseQuery("lamp", null, null, null, "", "100", ListingSort.NEWEST));
 ListingDetail detail = browse.openListing(listing.getId());     // adds one view
 SellerProfile seller = browse.getSellerProfile(listing.getSellerUsername());
This use case changes nothing except a listing's view count.

  • Method Details

    • search

      public List<Listing> search(BrowseQuery query)
      The live listings that match the query, in its sort order. A listing matches when its title or description contains the keyword (upper and lower case are the same) and it fits every chosen filter. For prices, a giveaway counts as HK$0 and a lend listing has no price: lend listings are left out when a price range is set, and come after the priced listings when sorting by price (Special Requirement 4).
      Returns:
      the matching listings; empty if none match (A1)
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the price range is invalid (A2)

    • openListing

      public ListingDetail openListing(String listingId)
      Opens a listing's detail screen: adds one to its view count (Special Requirement 2) and returns what the screen shows. A buyer can open any live listing, available or not, and any listing they have a deal on, whatever its status, so that it can be reopened from My Deals.
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if there is no such listing, or it is not live and the buyer has no deal on it

    • reloadListing

      public ListingDetail reloadListing(String listingId)
      What an already open detail screen should show now, without counting a view: for redrawing it after the buyer acted on the listing, for example after a claim made the giveaway unavailable (UC5).
      Throws:
      ServiceException - under the same conditions as openListing(java.lang.String)

    • getSellerProfile

      public SellerProfile getSellerProfile(String sellerUsername)
      The profile of a seller: full name, bio, average rating and reviews, each with the seller's reply, if any. Reviews the admin hid are left out (Special Requirement 5).
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the username is not a seller's
